001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * History log record Pumping Suspended, opCode 11, size 26.
009 *
010 * <br>
011 *
012 * 
013 * <table border='1'>
014 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
015 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>11</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
016 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Pumping Suspended"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_PUMPING_SUSPENDED"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
019 * </table>
020 */
021@HistoryLogProps(
022    opCode = 11,
023    displayName = "Pumping Suspended",
024    internalName = "LID_PUMPING_SUSPENDED",
025    usedByTidepool = true
026)
027public class PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
028
029    private long preSuspendState;
030    private int insulinAmount;
031    private int reasonId;
032    private int rpaTimeout;
033
034    public PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog() {}
035    public PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long preSuspendState, int insulinAmount, int reasonId, int rpaTimeout) {
036        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
037        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, preSuspendState, insulinAmount, reasonId, rpaTimeout);
038        this.preSuspendState = preSuspendState;
039        this.insulinAmount = insulinAmount;
040        this.reasonId = reasonId;
041        this.rpaTimeout = rpaTimeout;
042
043    }
044
045    public PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog(long preSuspendState, int insulinAmount, int reasonId, int rpaTimeout) {
046        this(0, 0, preSuspendState, insulinAmount, reasonId, rpaTimeout);
047    }
048
049    public int typeId() {
050        return 11;
051    }
052
053    /**
054     * <table border="1">
055     * <caption>Parsed fields for PumpingSuspendedHistoryLog:</caption>
056     * <tr><td><code>preSuspendState</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>insulinAmount</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>reasonId</code></td><td><code>raw[16]</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>rpaTimeout</code></td><td><code>raw[17]</code></td></tr>
060     * </table>
061     */
062    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
063        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
064        this.cargo = raw;
065        parseBase(raw);
066        this.preSuspendState = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
067        this.insulinAmount = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
068        this.reasonId = raw[16];
069        this.rpaTimeout = raw[17];
070
071    }
072
073    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long preSuspendState, int insulinAmount, int reason, int rpaTimeout) {
074        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
075            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(11, 0),
076            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
077            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
078            Bytes.toUint32(preSuspendState),
079            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(insulinAmount),
080            new byte[]{ (byte) reason, (byte) rpaTimeout }));
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * @return the state of the pump immediately before pumping was suspended
085     * (Tandem's pump-logs JSON calls this property preSuspendState).
086     * 106 in every record observed so far across t:slim X2 and Mobi, for both user-initiated
087     * and alarm-triggered suspends; no other value has been seen.
088     */
089    public long getPreSuspendState() {
090        return preSuspendState;
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * @return the insulin remaining in the reservoir as the pump reports it at the instant
095     * pumping was suspended, in whole units. This is the same number
096     * {@code InsulinStatusResponse.currentInsulinAmount} returns: on a Mobi capture the two were
097     * byte-identical when the status was polled within two seconds of the record, in 4 of 4
098     * suspends and 4 of 4 resumes. It is not the cartridge fill level (it dropped 110 -> 90
099     * across a tubing fill on the same cartridge) and it is not the IOB (the IOB the pump reports
100     * in LID_DAILY_BASAL decays over a suspension while this value does not). The paired
101     * suspended and resumed records which bracket a suspension carry the same value when nothing
102     * was delivered in between.
103     */
104    public int getInsulinAmount() {
105        return insulinAmount;
106    }
107    public int getReasonId() {
108        return reasonId;
109    }
110    public SuspendReason getReason() {
111        return SuspendReason.fromId(reasonId);
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * @return the resume pump alert (RPA) timeout in minutes: how long the pump waits while
116     * suspended before alerting that insulin delivery is still stopped. 0 when unset.
117     * The value 15 was observed on every suspend in a Mobi capture, and the suspensions that
118     * lasted longer than 15 minutes each raised RESUME_PUMP_ALARM (18) and RESUME_PUMP_ALARM2 (23)
119     * 15 min 1 s after the suspend, confirming the unit is minutes.
120     * (Tandem's pump-logs JSON calls this property rpaTimeout)
121     */
122    public int getRpaTimeout() {
123        return rpaTimeout;
124    }
125
126    public enum SuspendReason {
127        USER_ABORTED(0),
128        ALARM(1),
129        MALFUNCTION(2),
130        AUTO_SUSPEND_PREDICTIVE_LOW_GLUCOSE(6),
131
132        ;
133        private final int id;
134        SuspendReason(int id) {
135            this.id = id;
136        }
137
138        static SuspendReason fromId(int id) {
139            for (SuspendReason r : values()) {
140                if (r.id == id) {
141                    return r;
142                }
143            }
144            return null;
145        }
146    }
147
148}
